cohort: Women requiring blood transfusion for PPH (n=105) and women who did not receive blood transfusion (n=129) at a center in Brazil between 2012 and 2015
finding: Increased SI values within 2 hours postpartum were associated with the need for blood transfusion in women who had vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Increased SI values were associated with the need for transfusion in vaginal deliveries but not in cesarean deliveries.
